elements.text: You scroll through your feed and see everyone achieving things like getting into college and getting straight As in all their classes. You aren't planning to go to college next year, and you feel a pit of insecurity in your stomach. You wonder if you aren't as accomplished as your classmates. However, you also know that social media is a highlight reel that doesn't tell the whole...
